≈ **5 min**

Set up the Walk the Line lab

**01**Clear a **4 m** lane. Put the motion detector on a table at one end. Aim it down the lane.

**04****Check how close this detector** can measure. Ask your teacher where it is safe to start.

**05**Click **Collect**, then walk to match the target graph.
